en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused
zh: 自托管运行器：变更 `--repository-folder`，在 `--capacity 1` 时接受基础文件夹中的大多数文件夹（大于 1 时，其中存在一个会阻止启动）；另一仓库的 session 与其重叠时会被拒绝
